claims.text: Cal State LA and CSU Pueblo now share an unbeaten record Cal State LA were held at Cal State San Bernardino, and the draw leaves them on thirteen wins and two draws. That is exactly the record CSU Pueblo carry in the Rocky Mountain Athletic Conference, and neither side has lost a match this season.
